message: predicate application of an exported helper requires a termination promise
justification: A total application of an exported helper needs a published termination guarantee. The export is silent; its inspectable implementation is not a substitute for that promise.

message: predicate application requires a terminating helper with an empty crash ceiling
justification: Private progress can be checked from the body, but it does not turn the helper's declared Trap route into an empty crash ceiling.

message: predicate application requires a terminating helper with an empty crash ceiling
reference: CONTRACT.md#operations-and-declarations; wiki/spec/language/state_contracts.md (a total predicate term requires termination and absence of crash routes); src/declarations/contracts/predicate_calls.rs
justification: The helper explicitly permits Trap. At this call its signature cannot supply a total predicate; changing only the published ceiling to none supplies a backed Boolean application.

message: Psi has no specified edge for simultaneous domain removal and addition
gap: registry:simultaneous domain removal and addition
reference: CONTRACT.md#operations-and-declarations (a simultaneous removal and addition has an open Psi form)
justification: The retaining twin lowers in the same test. The contract says the replacing form is open in Psi.

message: owned element transfer selects outside its fixed array
reference: CONTRACT.md#operations-and-declarations (for owned fixed arrays, a frozen ordinal identifies the transferred element); wiki/spec/language/ownership.md:105-106; wiki/spec/terminal-psi/ownership.md:11-13; wiki/spec/terminal-psi/structural_access.md:214-215
justification: The owned transfer needs an element of the fixed shape. The frozen selector has no such element. The test checks the precise selector span.

message: a stored reference read needs its shared field place
gap: registry:reading a stored exclusive reference
justification: A non-mut binding may reborrow an @mut reached through a field, and an affine reference may be moved, so the read is valid. L5 forms only the shared reborrow; the shared twin returns through its stored loan in the same file.

message: unsupported domain member: Access
gap: registry:domain access policy
justification: This domain selects Rule::plan; L5 lacks the result of its admitted computation on the semantic schema. A plain scalar domain is a positive control, not the evaluated policy.

message: unsupported domain member: Access
gap: test:access plan evaluation at its domain
reference: CONTRACT.md#operations-and-declarations (access policies still require lowering); src/declarations/domains.rs
justification: Same program as tests/domains.rs. EvaluateAccessPlan names i32::Locked and Rule::plan at this clause. The selection does not supply the returned schema or issuance. The toolchain constructor is declaration-only.

message: template call needs its packaged declaration
gap: registry:unselected access policy template constructor
justification: Removing just the access selection removes EvaluateAccessPlan but leaves the policy machine. Packaging its open template stops at the call to the imported plan constructor.

message: predicate completion does not support a domain requiring parent membership
gap: registry:add an inherited child with its own predicate
justification: The child has a nonempty required membership. A proved completion for an unrestricted base predicate does not authorize this form.

message: transparent alias carry policy requires a checked relation to its expansion
gap: registry:carry policy on a transparent data alias
justification: The alias lists exactly u64's derived carry (suspension allowed, any CPU, any thread, movable), so it adds no demand. L3 publishes Copy and the four axes on Alias, with a separate normalized u64 target and no nominal Alias schema. The spec does not say whether a transparent alias may author a carry list that adds no demand, either equal to or weaker than its expansion's policy. The original case, which forbids suspension and pins the CPU on u64, is now refused in L3: a transparent alias cannot change its target's carry. The carry-free control lowers. Carry inherited through an alias from nominal data is not this case.

message: lowering has no matching `machine Step` binder for logical hypothesis `Step`
gap: registry:hypothesis outside a theorem binder
justification: Lowering needs a binder slot to publish this hypothesis. Whether the source itself must have an explicit binder remains unresolved. L3 also types a citation of this theorem with no evidence for the hypothesis, and lowering stops at the same name.

message: predicate application requires a terminating helper with an empty crash ceiling
justification: The callable alias owns the premise. Its helper now publishes a Trap route, so the alias clause cannot form a total predicate term; with crashes none the same clause lowers as a helper application on the binder interface.

message: predicate application requires a terminating helper with an empty crash ceiling
justification: The private helper has no crash clause and now calls a machine with a Trap route. L3 publishes no empty effect row for it, so the predicate cannot treat it as crash-free; returning its parameter instead lowers the same application.

message: static callback needs a local closed target and a supported structural contract
gap: registry:guarantee-bearing closed static callback
justification: The premise-bearing selection in the same test lowers. Adding only `ensures result == kept` to the Observer alias still stops in Callback::bind: the selection carries the bound's preconditions but no guarantee, and a binder guarantee reaches callers only through the separate callback result relation.

message: callback premise in a contract predicate has no Psi clause form
gap: registry:callback premise in a contract predicate
justification: `requires Observe(kept)` in the closed instance becomes a fact application of the selected machine, whose MachineApplication step owes only that machine's clauses. Under a bound with `requires premise(kept)` lowering would drop the bound's premise, so it stops. Without the bound's premise the same source lowers in the same test.

message: omitted field `Options::handle` of type `@u8` needs a borrowed reference, which `..` never supplies
gap: registry:omitted reference field without a backing value
reference: CONTRACT.md#operations-and-declarations; wiki/spec/language/data_and_literals.md#explicit-field-omission (the marker supplies no borrowed reference merely because storage can be zeroed); src/machines/construction.rs
justification: A `@u8` value borrows one referent, and no zero of that type borrows anything, so the omission can never be supplied. Changing only the field type to `u8` lowers the same literal with a zero in the handle slot.

message: owned element transfer requires a literal or frozen constant selector
gap: registry:owned element move with a runtime selector
reference: CONTRACT.md#operations-and-declarations (a move with a runtime selector is invalid); LOCK_EVIDENCE.md#what-a-consumer-can-distinguish; wiki/spec/language/ownership.md:105-107; wiki/spec/terminal-psi/ownership.md:11-13,20-22
justification: An owned extraction must name its unique element and cannot fall back to forgetting the root. A fixed-array claim path uses literal indexes, and dynamic indexes reject. The runtime selector names no element, so the program is invalid. The twin with a literal selector lowers.

message: cannot prove the store selector equal to or distinct from the selector of an open vacancy
gap: registry:restoration through an unproved selector
justification: Neither an absent nor an unrelated premise identifies how this store addresses every outstanding vacancy. L5 refuses before the ownership checker can judge restoration; a passing diagnostic test supplies no checker verdict.

message: cannot prove the store selector equal to or distinct from the selector of an open vacancy
gap: registry:restoration requiring transitive selector equality
justification: The two entry equalities imply i == j. Lowering recognizes only a direct selector clause and refuses before the checker can establish the transitive relation.

message: lowering only represents a computed rank that is one exact subtraction of formals or integer constants
gap: registry:non-exact computed ranking subject
justification: Terminal Psi names one exact subtraction over parameters and integer constants as a computed rank. K -% n, K -| n, K + n and K - n - 1 are not that form, and the language page does not say whether they are valid Nat\Descending subjects. The baseline refused all four with the operand message; K - n in the neighbouring test lowers.

message: vacuous completion does not support a domain requiring parent membership
gap: registry:add a tag child and a predicate domain in one cast
justification: The tag child T::C requires its parent T. A vacuous origin needs empty required memberships, the same rule that refuses the inherited predicate child. Without the child, x as +P +Tag lowers with one origin per domain.

message: proof citation requires a terminating helper with an empty crash ceiling
justification: The cited helper publishes a Trap route, so its guarantee holds only if it completes. A theorem proof executes nothing and has no crash route to cover; L3 also owes crash coverage at this citation. Without the route the same citation lowers as a proof step.

message: a theorem subject other than a variable or a closed literal needs an erased subject term
gap: registry:theorem subject computed from a variable
justification: x+1 as a theorem subject, in an executable citation and in a theorem proof. A theorem binds arbitrary eligible subjects, but Psi has no erased arithmetic term, and computing the value at runtime would make the erased citation demand x and possibly trap. Literals, folded constants and frozen constants already lower.

message: a theorem body citing another logical theorem needs theorem-application proof steps
gap: registry:theorem application inside a theorem proof
justification: The outer proof instantiates another theorem with lemma as its hypothesis evidence. The spec admits evidence obtained by instantiating another theorem; a proof step for it needs the binder evidence and subjects, and only bindings and machine citations are proof steps today.

message: open generic machine requires a closed application before lowering
gap: registry:constant operand in an open template body
reference: CONTRACT.md#handoffs-and-remaining-work (a constant operand such as F(b,a) + 1 has no template operand form); src/declarations/machine_templates.rs
justification: Only the second operand of the published sum differs. A closed body lowers the literal as a constant, but an open template's operands name only formals and earlier steps.

message: open generic machine requires a closed application before lowering
gap: registry:record carrier of an open template value binder
reference: CONTRACT.md#handoffs-and-remaining-work (a record carrier has no template binder form); src/declarations/machine_templates/lexical.rs; wiki/spec/language/generics.md#value-binders-and-const-requirements
justification: Only the binder's carrier differs from the published u8 binder. MachineTemplateBinder::Const is published for bool and fixed-width integer carriers; a static record value has no template binder form yet.

message: template call has unsupported operands, selection or obligations
gap: registry:affine field operand of a formal record
reference: CONTRACT.md#handoffs-and-remaining-work (a field operand is a copy; moving an affine field has no template operand form); src/declarations/machine_templates.rs (copied_whole); wiki/spec/terminal-psi/ownership.md#partial-ownership-and-residuals
justification: Audio::play(track.tag) passes the affine record field Audio::tag. Passing it moves the field out of the formal and leaves the residual volume, a partial transfer the open template's call list cannot state, so lowering stops at the call. Declaring Tag [copy] turns the same call into a structural copy that lowers.
